args.note: Journalist requested confirmation of the product delay. Per policy, external messages require sign-off from the head of communications. Requested approval for the confirmation message to press, but the head of communications is in transit and the request remains pending (unapproved). No message has been sent to the journalist. Cannot send a holding message either, as that too is an external communication requiring the same sign-off, which has not been granted. Awaiting approval before further action.
